blocks.text: Expand this section only when you need implementation detail. The story above is the recruiter path.

rows: Recipient pays courier face value (e.g. ৳2,200) — **not** booked as merchant sales
B2B merchant bill issued (e.g. ৳1,500) + courier AP (e.g. ৳80)
Net remittance (e.g. ৳2,120) allocates to merchant bill
Surplus (e.g. ৳620) credits dropshipper custody cashbook for payout

items.text: Record shipment cost buckets → draft AP bills per bucket × currency.
Pay vendors → FX from actual pays → restamp unit cost on open lots.
Corrections via credit/debit notes — not silent edits to issued AP.
Local workflow: edit schemas → `db diff` → migration → `backend:local` replay on Docker Supabase.
Frontend: route-level CSS split (~67% first-load CSS reduction on initial shell) and lazy heavy libs (Mermaid, ExcelJS, FCM).
Migration ordering and schema split for safe empty-DB replay.
Money-kernel alignment across wholesale, shop order, dropship settlement, and inbound AP.
Platform/docs narrative and VPC structure for operators (in-product guide at `/docs` on the product SPA).
